bug.description: requirements.txt pins `psycopg[binary]==3.2`. The psycopg 3.2 release metadata makes its `binary` extra require `psycopg-binary==3.2.0.dev1`, which is not on PyPI, so `pip install -r requirements.txt` fails in a clean environment. The workflow's "Install dependencies" step runs exactly that command, so CI would fail at that step before any test runs (the index is platform independent, so this is expected on ubuntu-latest too). The user's existing environment likely only works because psycopg-binary is already installed. Fix needs requirements.txt (e.g. psycopg[binary]==3.2.13, or psycopg==3.2.0 with psycopg-binary==3.2.0), which the spec forbids changing, so the spec needs an amendment.
